Introduction: This dataset provides geometric parameters for the regular 0.5-degree lat-lon grid from the ECCO V-NUM-r-NUM-PROPER-ENGLISH-UPPERCASE-placeholder (V-NUM-r-NUM-placeholder) ocean and sea-ice state estimate. Parameters include areas and lengths of grid cell sides, horizontal and vertical coordinates of grid cell centers and corners, and global domain geometry including bathymetry and land/ocean masks.
